rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Rest and motion are not properties of a body alone. They depend on the frame.  ·  Speed and velocity are not interchangeable when the path bends or reverses.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: A pseudo-force is used only in a non-inertial frame.  ·  Earth is taken as inertial unless the question says the frame accelerates.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: A frame of reference is the body, or the set of axes, from which positions and times are measured. The same motion can look different in two frames. A passenger at rest in a train is moving in the platform frame.  ·  An inertial frame is one in which Newton's first law holds. A frame fixed to the Earth is close enough for the problems in this course. A frame that accelerates, such as a braking bus, is non-inertial, and a pseudo-force is then added if you still want to use F = ma inside it.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Statics is not a different kind of force. It is the zero-acceleration case.  ·  Subtracting speeds that point in different directions as if they were scalars gives the wrong relative velocity.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: Mechanics divides into kinematics, dynamics and statics. Kinematics describes motion with displacement, velocity and acceleration, without asking for the force. Dynamics relates the motion to forces. Statics is dynamics with zero acceleration.  ·  Relative velocity of A with respect to B is v_A − v_B. The subtraction is a vector subtraction. If the bodies move on one line, opposite directions get opposite signs.  ·  Displacement is the change of position and is a vector. Distance is the length of the path and is a scalar. Speed is distance over time. Velocity is displacement over time.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Relative velocity  ·  Relative velocity uses a vector difference.  ·  Motion, Frames of Reference & Branches of Mechanics is based on fundamental principles.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Distance cannot be negative. Displacement can.  ·  A body can have zero velocity and non-zero acceleration at one instant, as at the top of a throw.  ·  Relative velocity is a vector difference.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: A rest statement is incomplete until the frame is named. Rest in one frame can be motion in another.
